newsitem.title: USA: Ohio Edison names chairman, president.
newsitem.headline: Ohio Edison names chairman, president.

text.p: Ohio Edison Co said Tuesday it had named Willard Holland chairman and chief executive, and Peter Burg president and chief operating officer.
Previously, Holland was president and chief executive, while Burg was senior vice president and chief financial officer.
Holland continues to serve as chairman of the board and chief executive of the company's subsidiary, Pennsylvania Power.
Burg continues to serve as chief financial officer.

The company said the changes, which are effective November 1, will allow Holland to concentrate on the management transition prompted by the company's recently announced merger with Centerior Energy Corp into a new holding company named FirstEnergy Corp.
Holland will serve as chairman of the FirstEnergy transition team, Ohio Edison said.
